# v0.23.3 — Native recovery and replay continuity

Promotes the runtime bytes qualified in `v0.23.3-rc2`. The only source-tree
change from that candidate is this added release-note file. Native recovery
remains opt-in; this release does not enable it on existing installations.

## Native recovery and replay continuity (#461, #462)

- Adds `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY`: LCM preserves durable source history while the
  Hermes native compressor summarizes active context. Native recovery does not
  publish an LCM summary or advance the LCM frontier.
- Below-threshold ingest cleanup sanitizes active replay without requesting a
  native summary. Threshold pressure, overflow, and forced compression still
  dispatch recovery.
- Native success validates the protected fresh tail, respects observed token
  pressure, preserves replay provenance across restart, and reconciles host
  adoption or rejection before committing ingest progress.
- The feature remains disabled unless `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY=true` is configured.

## Review-evidence integrity (#465, #466)

- Protected review evidence preserves reviewers' literal verdicts rather than
  translating them into invented scores.
- Receipt publication and validation bind the exact repository, pull request,
  base, head, lane, issuer, and original evidence. Withdrawn or malformed
  evidence fails closed.

## Records (#431)

- Backfills the benchmark run log; no runtime behavior change.

## RC qualification

`RELEASE-READINESS-V1` ran against RC2 commit
`b2dcf8f22758a21341b6c27a54c5215fa51ca91c`, tree
`96b0b3f8eb2712636dc171a9c1bf44b830d6ec04`.

- [Phase A](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.23.3/PHASE-A-RECEIPT.md):
  all 15 registered tools passed in live cloud-default and local postures;
  all four privacy batteries passed.
- [Phase B](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.23.3/PHASE-B-RECEIPT.md):
  independent cross-model review of the full previous-stable-to-RC2 diff found
  no verified release blocker. A previous-stable-created database passed the
  preservation, local re-embedding, recall and integrity exercise.
- [Phase C](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/download/v0.23.3/PHASE-C-RECEIPT.md):
  35 material turns and three exact recall probes completed with automatic
  in-place compaction and no unexpected engine or publication errors. Same-store
  doctor found no integrity issues. Four empty lifecycle rows were inspected and
  accepted under the documented warning-only policy; they were not deleted.

Hermes qualification host: `639823919ced15640924e905bacab3858c5afd19`.
That host's ACP coding posture does not expose the context-engine doctor tool;
the supported operator doctor supplied same-store closeout health. This release
does not claim to change that host behavior or to eliminate lifecycle warnings.

## Distribution and proof boundary

The managed archive and checksum/pin manifests identify one immutable payload.
The compatibility plugin identifier remains `hermes-lcm`; no public LCM tool API
change is planned by this promotion. Verify the archive checksum before install.

Release qualification does not establish installed fleet identity, per-profile
rollback, Golden/provisioning acceptance, customer-channel delivery, or customer
satisfaction. Those remain separate deployment acceptance gates.
